    • Card capsules

    card-list in both variants, and two independent photo-card galleries.

    card-list, default spacing

    Hover one card. It lifts and scales; siblings scale down slightly. Nothing reflows.

    First

    Radius choreography rounds the top of the first item.

    Middle

    Middle items keep the tighter radius.

    Last

    The last item rounds its bottom corners.

    card-list--dense

    Same capsule, --dense modifier: more padding, larger internal gaps.

    Dense first

    Used by the thayn.me blog index for post cards.

    Dense last

    Hover behaviour matches the default variant.

    photo-card, default gallery

    <drop capsule="photo-card" data-count="3"> reading data/photos.json. Click a card: the modal is labelled by the photo title, traps focus, and Escape returns focus to the card.

    photo-card, second gallery on the same page

    A second drop with data-path="/data/portraits.json" and data-count="1". It must show exactly one card from a different file, proving the two galleries do not share state.
